Brand – Brandnertal's family reputation is well earned: dedicated beginner areas, a well-organised childcare service, well-groomed green runs and a friendly atmosphere at the foot of the lifts. Brand – Brandnertal's altitude (904 m at the base, 2,000 m at the top) allows it to maintain decent snow cover through the depths of winter. It is an honest destination, often underestimated, that deserves to be (re)discovered.
